description: This file contains functions and types related to managing boards and blocks in a SQL store, including creation, patching, deletion, and duplication of boards and blocks, with error handling and external dependencies on models and SQL query builder.

classes.name: BlockDoesntBelongToBoardsErr
classes.description: Custom error type indicating a block does not belong to specified boards.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns an error message for BlockDoesntBelongToBoardsErr.

methods.name: createBoardsAndBlocksWithAdmin
methods.description: Creates boards and blocks with admin rights, assigns admin members to boards.

methods.name: createBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Creates new boards and blocks in the database.

methods.name: patchBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Patches existing boards and blocks based on provided patches.

methods.name: deleteBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Deletes specified boards and blocks, ensuring blocks belong to the boards.

methods.name: duplicateBoard
methods.description: Duplicates a board, optionally as a template, and copies associated blocks.
